finalText:
**1082 occurrences across 94 files** — mostly service, repo, and route code in `orders`, `notify`, `billing`, `analytics`, `accounts`. That part is a mechanical rename.

Three places it must stay `account_id`:

| Location | Why |
|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml`, [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Public API field, frozen contract per `docs/openapi.yaml:6` |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/src/*.js` | Third-party vendored SDK, not ours to rename |
| `migrations/*.sql` (applied ones, e.g. `20250114_create_accounts.sql`) | Already run in prod, editing history breaks the down step |

`lib/audit.js` also hardcodes `account_id` on every audit line — check whether audit consumers key on that name before touching it.

Sign-off: safe to approve the internal rename, with those three carved out explicitly.

Next: confirm with platform team the DB column itself isn't in scope, only code-level identifiers.
